chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Al-Haytham ibn Waqid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever is content with Allah with the little of livelihood, Allah will be pleased with him with the little of deeds.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for being content with modest livelihood?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from Al-Kafi underscores that spiritual sufficiency (rida) outweighs material abundance, serving as a key mechanism for elevating the weight of minor deeds. It reflects the Imami emphasis on inner contentment as a prerequisite for divine acceptance, linking human gratitude directly to God's mercy. This reciprocal dynamic illustrates how modesty in worldly desire fosters magnanimity in divine reward.
